partition: Every fifth row of patient_info.csv is held out; all records from a patient remain in one partition. Exploratory internal validation, not external validation.
evidence_scope: A compatible validation model is not independent confirmation of the original implementation. Fixed candidate intervals came from published standards; numerical parameters and inverse scripts are confidential.
midpoint_sd_comparator: Reference-midpoint SD under an explicit normal-reference assumption; detailed parameters are confidential. This is not a test of every possible z-score fitted elsewhere.
mch_rounding: The tested MCH tolerance accommodates different rounding precision across source label groups; all held-out rows remain in the denominator.
